resources.string: No stamp yet. Write in another language: as soon as someone replies, the first one arrives.
Every language you have really exchanged in — one message sent and one received with someone who writes it — adds a stamp to your passport.
received — a sent message is missing
sent — a received message is missing
Your Atlas is private by default: a language can say a lot about you. You choose who sees it. The game keeps the language, both directions and the date — never the other person or the conversation.
No journey under way right now
Alliance left. A new alliance opens next week.
%s offers you an alliance for the week.
Invitation sent to %s. Waiting for the answer.
The alliance opens at level %1$s, for both of you. You are at level %2$s.
You need an accepted friend to form an alliance.
Choose a friend to form an alliance: if each of you does your part within the week, the reward doubles.
Doubled if each of you does your part.
You are in the highest circle of the jousts.
How you’re placed: by the sparks your moves make fly, alongside heroes of similar activity.
A risk to be aware of: from one day to the next, your total shows that you played that day.
What others see: your joust name, your joust and your sparks for the week, updated once a day at 4 a.m.
Who sees it: up to 29 other heroes in your joust, whom you don’t know. No name, no photo, no language.
You can withdraw your consent at any time with one tap, here or in settings. Your joust data is deleted within 4 weeks at the latest.
The group is filling up: the places appear as soon as the first sparks fall.
This week’s sparks, among accepted friends. Always open, no consent to give.
Add friends to compare yourself with them every week.
You climb to the next circle if you keep your place.
The joust opens at level %1$s: each week, you measure yourself against 29 heroes whose light is like yours. You are at level %2$s.
The public joust isn’t open for your account. The Friends’ Joust always is.
Your joust name is drawn at random: not your name, not your username. It changes with every journey.
The others’ places are set every day at 4 a.m.: nobody sees who is playing right now. Only your own row is live.
Noted. You will be placed in a group at the start of next week.
Offline: this action will resume when you are back online.
Rebirth opens at level 100. You are at level %s.
Your legend has lived its five rebirths: the summit of summits.
Level 100: your light can be reborn, or keep growing.

When you are reborn, your light becomes a Spark again: your level starts over at 1 and your sparks at 0. What you have received since the beginning and your highest light stay engraved. Your ancestors offer you a new Age, a numbered trophy and %s glory. Your rank never goes back.
Journey accomplished: a cup, a dated medal and %s glory.
Each act you complete and each alliance carry you a few strides: %s strides lead to the next stop. The whole journey is free.
No journey is under way right now. The next one sets off soon.
The Seal is purely decorative: a collectible every %s stops, which changes nothing in the game.
Mee and Meo’s cards and the signs from your ancestors that appear on Progress. This setting applies to this device only.
Show the signs from your ancestors
Your accepted friends see you in their weekly ranking, and you see them in yours. You can opt out in one tap: you no longer appear in theirs, and you no longer see theirs.
Stop taking part in the Friends’ Joust
Hides the game everywhere on this device, closes your trophies, your rank, your Legacy and your Atlas to everyone else, and takes you out of the public joust. Your sparks and your trophies are kept.
The game is hidden on this device.
Your visibility settings stay closed: reopen them here whenever you like.
You are not in the public joust. Your Friends’ Joust stays open.
You are in the public joust under the name %s.
You are in the public joust.
An alliance offer, a joust result, a journey stop: at most one game notification a day. This setting applies to your account, on all your devices.
Outside accepted friends, nobody sees whether you are online or when you play. These settings say what your friends, or everyone, can see of your game.
Your trophies are waiting for you. Joust and journey cups, Rebirth and Flame trophies take their place here as you win them.
A visitor only sees the month you won a trophy, never the exact date. “Only me” hides your trophies from everyone else.
This part of the game is not available on your server yet.
Send a message and get one back in a language: the stamp lands.
Write to someone in a language other than yours.
Wait for the reply: it takes a message each way.
Look at the half-finished exchanges: one sent or one received message is missing to place the stamp. Your Atlas is private by default: you choose who sees it.
The Atlas is your passport of languages: the lands your voice has crossed, one stamp for each language truly exchanged.
The Atlas keeps a stamp for every language you’ve chatted in.
Repeat a move: its medal changes material, from copper to prism.
Pick an action you like and do it often.
A medal that went out lights up again: nothing is lost.
Tap a medal to see what it follows, its material and what’s missing for the next star. A mint never puts one out: a medal tells your real total.
A medal follows one precise move: a voice message, a story, a friendship made. There are twenty.
A medal shows what you do most on Meeshy.
Each tier you reach opens the next one, a little higher.
Look at the next tier and work towards it.
Try new actions: each one has its challenges.
Open the list, spot the closest tier and work towards it. Each tier shows its rarity.
A challenge is a numbered tier in a family of actions: a number to reach.
Challenges are tiers to clear, one after another.
Do actions from several families these days to trigger it.
Mix it up: write, post, comment, react.
Come back several days in a row to keep it.
See which families are active, then make a move in a family that’s missing. While the momentum holds, every move makes more sparks fly.
Momentum is a spark multiplier. It switches on when you are active in several families of actions these days.
Momentum multiplies the sparks of your next actions.
One move a day tends it; a Vigil guards it for a day.
Do at least one action every day.
Keep a Vigil for the days off.
Each day of Flame adds 2 % to the sparks of your dreams, up to 50 %. A Vigil guards it for one day away. Once out, it can be relit with Meeshes for 48 hours.
Your Flame is the fire your ancestors entrust to you: it grows every day you make at least one move, and changes form as it grows, from Ember to Sun.
Your Flame tells your days in a row, and it feeds your dreams.
Mints, new levels and great deeds make your glory grow.
Mint a Meesh: every mint makes your glory grow.
Carry your light higher than ever and perform great deeds.
Your rank shows on your crest and on your profile. It also opens your light: up to level 499 below Ambassador, 1000 from Ambassador, no limit from Oracle.
Your glory grows and never goes back. It gives you your rank, one of eleven: from Whisper to Legend, then Myth.
Your glory gives you your name, and that name never goes back.
Your sparks of the week set your place; the first ones climb.
Play a little every day: the week’s sparks add up.
Aim for the top spots before Sunday evening.

Look at your place and your zone: the top 7 climb to the next circle, the bottom 5 go back down. Everything starts again from zero each Monday. The public joust needs your consent; the Friends’ Joust is always open.
The joust is the week’s contest: thirty heroes of similar light measure themselves there under their joust names. There are eight circles, from Quartz to Prism.
Each week, the joust measures you against 29 other heroes.
Your sparks feed the ring: when it’s full, your light gains a level.
Fulfill each night’s dream: its acts make lots of sparks fly.
Keep your Flame lit: it feeds your dreams.

Your light opens the dream at level 5, the joust at 10, the alliance at 20 and rebirth at 100. Every ten levels, from 10 to 100, your ancestors ask for a trial. Minting a Meesh binds part of your light and lowers your level, but the joust and the alliance, once open, stay open.

Your level is the number at the centre of your ring. It is read from your light: 10,000 sparks for level 10, a million for level 100. Minting a Meesh binds part of it, so it lowers your level; what you received stays received.
Your light tells how far you’ve come on Meeshy.
Minting a Meesh binds part of your light into a coin.
Keep your Meeshes: your legacy moves from one container to the next.
Spend them to watch over your Flame or to change an act of your dream.

Keep your Meeshes: they fill your legacy, from the Purse to the Reserve, shown on your profile. Or spend them: a Vigil for your Flame, an act to change, the Journey Seal. Every mint also makes your glory grow.
A Meesh is your light bound into a numbered coin, which you mint yourself. One in a hundred is gold, one in a thousand is prism.
The Meeshes you keep form the legacy you leave to your line.
Three acts per dream. Once they’re complete, the Offering appears.
Don’t like an act? Change it, once a day.
Open an act to see where you stand. You can change one a day with a Meesh. Once all three are complete, open the Offering: sparks, glory, sometimes a bonus, a star fragment or a Vigil.
Each night, a dream in three acts: small goals to fulfill during the day, richer and richer in glory. The Offering comes with it.
Each night, your ancestors send you a dream to fulfill.
Every real exchange makes them fly: writing, talking, posting, reacting.
Post, comment, react: each move makes its own sparks fly.
Build momentum to multiply your sparks.
Your light mints the Meeshes of your legacy. Minting a Meesh binds part of it into the coin: your light, and so your level, drops by as much. What you received stays received.
Every real exchange makes sparks fly: together, they form your light. The more it grows, the brighter it shines, and how bright it shines is your level.
Your sparks form your light; how bright it shines is your level.
Your light becomes a Spark again and your legend enters a new Age.
Carry your light all the way to level 100.
Be reborn whenever you like: nothing forces you to.

At level 100, choose: be reborn, or keep shining. Being reborn sets your level back to 1 and your light to zero. You keep the sparks received since the beginning, your highest light, your rank, your glory, your Meeshes, your Flame and your trophies; your joust and your alliance stay open.
Rebirth opens a new Age of your legend, offered at level 100, when your light has become a Galaxy. It is optional: five rebirths at most lead to the Sixth Age.
Rebirth is offered to those whose light reaches level 100.
Each act you complete carries you a few strides, from stop to stop.
Complete the acts of your dream to move a few strides.
Form an alliance with a friend: the reward doubles.
Move a few strides, then claim each stop you reach: sparks, a star fragment, a Vigil. The finished journey gives the journey cup. The Journey Seal is a collectible, taken with Meeshes.
A journey lasts eight weeks, in the land of a language, with forty stops and their free gifts.
Eight weeks in the land of a language, with a cup at the end.
Each cup lands there by itself. You choose the order and who sees it.
Finish at the top of your joust to win a cup.
Complete a journey or be reborn.
Arrange your trophies in the order you like and choose who sees them: everyone, your friends or only you. A trophy brings nothing: it is there to be shown.
The shelf of your trophies: joust and journey cups, rebirth and Flame trophies.
Your trophies keep the memory of your victories.
It is done in one go, when you gather what it asks for.
Explore the app: some great deeds are hidden.
The rarest ones make your glory grow the most.
Open a great deed to read what it asks for. Once done, it makes your glory grow: the rarer it is, the more it grows.
A great deed is a distinction done only once, with its date and its rarity.
A great deed marks a rare moment in your legend.
Complete the dream’s three acts first: the Offering will appear.
One of you already has an alliance this week.
The alliance opens at level 20, for both of you.
This alliance no longer exists: the screen is refreshing.
An alliance is formed between accepted friends.
This move makes no sense for this alliance.
Two Vigils already guard your Flame: that’s the most you can have.
That did not go through — check your connection and try again.
You need one more Meesh for that.
Your light doesn’t hold enough sparks yet to mint a Meesh.
First agree to join the public joust.
The public joust is only open to accounts whose adulthood is verified.
This joust name isn’t allowed: choose one that doesn’t point to you.
This joust name isn’t valid: 3 to 20 characters, letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
This joust name is already taken.
This act no longer exists: the screen is refreshing.
You already changed an act today.
Your ancestors send you their dreams from level 5.
Your legend has already lived its five rebirths.
The part of your light to bind changed in the meantime: nothing was taken. Check it, then mint again.
The Flame cannot be relit right now.
That request was already used for another action — try again.
You already have this journey’s Seal.
This stop has already been claimed.
This stop hasn’t been reached yet.
This container of your Legacy opens with a higher rank.
A shadow veils your light: your next sparks will clear it. While it’s there, no Meesh can be minted.
Comment on a public post by someone you don’t know
Comment on %s public posts by people you don’t know
Chat with someone who speaks another language
Chat with %s people who speak another language
Get an invited person to join Meeshy
Get %s invited people to join Meeshy
Write %s messages in a language other than yours
Write a message in a language other than yours
Write %s messages in a language other than yours
React to %s message in a conversation
React to %s messages in your conversations
Reply to someone in their language
Reply %s times to someone in their language
Write to someone for the first time
Write to %s people for the first time
At level 5, your ancestors send you a dream in three acts each night, and an Offering. You are at level %s.
No activity yet. Send a message, post a story… your first medal lights up with your very first move.
Offline — progress as of the last opening
Offline — no progress in memory. It will show once you’re back online.
